name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: Something is working and there is no number to show yet. The shadcn core `spinner` item, drawn in Interlace tokens. Use `Progress` when you know how far along it is, and `Skeleton` when you know the shape of what is coming.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/spinner

Installed to `components/ui/spinner.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/spinner';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/spinner

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
